QF.id: AIFM CII Legal Documents and Negotiations_22

question.text: Under the SEBI circular on Investor Charter for AIFs, how must the Investor Charter be published for a NEW AIF scheme?

answer.text: It should be disclosed to investors on their registered e-mail ID as a one-time measure.
It should be disclosed in the PPM of the new scheme.
It should be uploaded on the AMFI website within 30 days of scheme launch.
It should be filed separately with SEBI prior to launch, outside the PPM.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that for new AIF schemes the Investor Charter must be disclosed in the PPM of that scheme, while for existing schemes it had to be disclosed to investors by registered e-mail as a one-time measure. The Trap: The registered-e-mail mechanism applies only to existing schemes. AMFI is the mutual-fund industry body and is not the disclosure channel for the AIF Investor Charter; nor is the Charter filed outside the PPM as a stand-alone SEBI filing. Note: The Investor Charter forms part of the new-scheme PPM, so it travels through the merchant-banker filing and SEBI observations process with the rest of the PPM contents.
